verdict.rationale: Supabase ships a first-party AI Assistant built into the Dashboard. It generates schema SQL from specifications, diagnoses SQL errors, and gives table-context recommendations. It also offers one explicit delegation path: generating and deploying Edge Functions automatically via the Assistant. Most documented behaviour is generate/suggest rather than end-to-end task execution, so delegation is only partly evidenced. missing for 10: documented autonomous execution of general dashboard tasks beyond Edge Function deployment (e.g., applying migrations or managing settings directly), approval/guardrail controls for the in-product assistant, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: You can also use Supabase's AI Assistant to generate and deploy functions automatically. Go to your project > Deploy a new function > Via AI Assistant.
Supabase AI Assistant is integrated into the Supabase Dashboard to drastically improve your database management experience
when designing a new database schema, it can generate all necessary SQL queries based on your specifications
